## Assessment Summary

**Job:** DD-UARCH-L5 — Senior Staff Engineer, Microarchitecture (Digital Design), family_group=engineering, level_code=L5, IC track, target bonus 15%.

**Market data (US-SJC, engineering L5, aged to 2026-08-01 @3.5% growth):** Direct survey match found (SYN-044-DD-UARCH-L5), p25 ≈ $181,904, p50 ≈ $216,552, p75 ≈ $255,532.

**Candidate offer:** 15,000,000 INR converted to USD at the August 2026 rate (0.011442) = $171,630.

**Pay metrics** (using survey p25/p50/p75 as proxy min/mid/max since no explicit salary-structure range was queried): compa-ratio vs. p50-based mid ≈ 0.79, range penetration ≈ -14% (i.e., below the p25 floor — negative penetration), cost-to-minimum ≈ $10,274 to reach the p25 floor.

**Internal equity check:** No current incumbents found in job_id=DD-UARCH-L5 / geo_code=US-SJC, so no peer compa-ratio distribution is available for comparison.

**Bottom line:** After FX conversion, the offer sits noticeably below market — under the p25 and well under the p50 for this exact job/level/geo slice (compa-ratio ~0.79 against mid, negative range penetration). No internal peers exist yet to benchmark against for equity purposes. On market data alone, this placement looks hard to defend as competitive; it would need additional justification (e.g., a below-market band, internal budget constraints, or a different intended range structure) to support it as-is.
